title: Ordered word counts
prompt: Implement `std::map<std::string, int> word_counts(const std::vector<std::string>& words)` counting occurrences of each word. The returned `map` must iterate in sorted key order — that ordering is part of the contract, so an unordered_map will fail the sorted test.

tests.name: basic
tests.hint: operator[] inserts 0 for missing keys, then ++ counts.

tests.name: sorted-order
tests.hint: A std::map iterates keys in sorted order.
